narrationTexts: Confirmed: 3 failures, all in `orderTotal` — it taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount. Fixing `src/pricing.js`.
finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39-43`: it computed tax on the original pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, and added the two independently-rounded pieces together instead of rounding once at the end. Fixed to discount first, then tax the discounted total (`applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`), matching the spec in `cases.js`.
